title: envelopes.v1
description: Every message that transits the relay is one of these typed envelopes. The server stores and forwards them; it never generates, rewrites, or interprets content (zero server-side inference). MESSAGE.text is the only free-text field in the whole network and it is end-user-authored (or drafted by the user's own local agent and explicitly approved by the user before sending — the MCP tool contract mandates showing the draft). v0 HONESTY: MESSAGE bodies are visible to the server; E2E encryption is a fast-follow. The post-reveal enrichment-narrative attachment is a RESERVED envelope type (see PROTOCOL.md) and does not exist in v0.

role_card.description: The structured 'job post' inside an INTEREST. Company NAME is deliberately absent — pre-reveal, a hirer is exactly as pseudonymous as a builder (size + sector only). No free text.

comp_band.description: OPTIONAL banded annual compensation, USD-equivalent, gross. Coarse by design.

oneOf.title: INTEREST
oneOf.description: Hirer → builder. Creates a conversation in state `interested`. Quota-enforced (10/day/hirer in v0).

oneOf.title: ACCEPT_CHAT
oneOf.description: Builder only, from `interested`. Opens free-text messaging — the builder's attention is opt-in, not just their identity.

oneOf.title: MESSAGE
oneOf.description: Both sides, ONLY in state `active`. ≤2000 chars. Server-visible in v0 (stated plainly in NETWORK-PROMISES.md).

oneOf.title: REVEAL_REQUEST
oneOf.description: Either side, from `active`. Moves the conversation to `reveal_pending`. Does NOT count as the requester's approval — approval is a separate explicit act by each side.

oneOf.title: REVEAL_APPROVE
oneOf.description: Each side, in `reveal_pending`. The consent event. Irrevocable once BOTH sides have approved (fulfillment is immediate on the second approval). The contact-card email is the vault's verified email — it cannot be substituted here; display_name is the only approval-time field.

display_name.description: Optional human name to put on the contact card.

oneOf.title: WITHDRAW
oneOf.description: Either side, from any non-terminal state (`interested`, `active`, `reveal_pending`). Terminal. Withdrawing before reveal fulfillment cancels the reveal.
